lessons: In chupa/drain.py, a machine-actor keep that takes a stem out of the Reject queue must always draw one retry unit, even when the terminal's dispatch is spec_gap_hold. Only a released hold that never reached the Reject queue may re-run without a draw.

The ticket's Definition of rejected forbids any machine release that draws no retry unit. A spec_gap_hold terminal carrying plan_units becomes a plan-bound Reject arrival once _settle journals reject_arrival after any cap is spent, so it gets the same retry draw.

Add a tests/test_drain.py case for this: a spec_gap_hold terminal with diagnosis spent and retry unspent, whose bound unit changes. Assert one machine keep, exactly one retry draw, and then the re-run.
Keep the rest of the merged work, which passed all 2150 tests. The finding is limited to the draw-skip condition near chupa/drain.py:382, so change only that condition and do not widen the scope.
